skilltype.minions.desc: Summons several minions around itself each time it triggers.
skilltype.illusions.desc: Spawns fragile copies of itself to confuse players.
skilltype.spectral_vanish.desc: Turns invisible, gains speed and teleports a short distance away (random trigger).

skilltype.resurrection.desc: Passive aura: undead killed near the caster may rise again as Revenants.
skilltype.burial.desc: The earth grabs the target (Slowness, no jumping), then dead rise from the ground around it.
skilltype.eruption.desc: A ring of flames warns, then a geyser bursts under players: damages, burns and launches them up.

skilltype.burning_touch.desc: Passive flame aura: burns and hurts players who get too close.
skilltype.blink.desc: Teleports behind its target and strikes, with bonus damage.
skilltype.gravity_well.desc: Opens a vortex under the target: pulls players to the center, hurts them, then implodes and launches them.

skilltype.grave_grip.desc: A player who stands still is dragged underground: pinned and hurt every second. Keep moving.

skilltype.homing_orbs.desc: Fires homing orbs (levitation on hit): they can be destroyed in one hit or dodged.
skilltype.doom_mark.desc: Dooms a player: after a delay, a huge blow is shared between the players near them. Alone, it's deadly.

codex.bossrush.body:
§7A horde played with §fonly its bosses§7, back to back. No monster waves, special waves, chaos events or Breaches.

§6§lHow to play
§7• At the altar, click §f⚔ Boss Rush§7 (click again for the §cGauntlet§7), then launch the horde.
§7• It unlocks once you have finished that horde (editable per horde).
§7• Available for hordes that have bosses, classic or Kingdom.

§6§lRules
§7• The team shares a few §flives§7: every death costs one, and with none left the Boss Rush is lost.
§7• Between two bosses: a short pause (20 s by default) with merchants, supply chests and blessings, and you recover your health.
§7• A §ftimer§7 runs the whole time. Best times are saved: §e/ws bossrush§7 shows them.
§7• §cGauntlet§7: each boss is stronger than the previous one.

§6§lKingdom mode
§7• Every Assault is a boss, with no monsters or siege units. Calms stay: build and repair between bosses.
§7• The Gates stay as scenery and as the places where bosses appear: no Guardians, no Catalysts.
§7• Victory: defeat the last boss. You do not have to destroy the Gates.

§6§lRewards
§7• The usual boss loot, plus Renaissance Points for each boss defeated and a bonus on victory.
§7• No first-victory bonus, and it does not count as finishing the horde.
§7• Works with difficulties and mutators.

§7Operators can tune everything in §e/ws editor§7, tab §fBoss§7, button §f👑 Boss Rush settings§7: lives, pause, which bosses, Gauntlet strength, rewards, time limit…

codex.daily.body:
§7Every day brings a new challenge: a §fdifficulty§7 (Normal, Hard or Nightmare) and §f3 mutators§7, the same for every player and every server (the day changes at midnight UTC).

§6§lHow it works
§7• At the altar, click §f📅 Daily Challenge§7: it selects the difficulty and the 3 mutators for you.
§7• Win the horde (classic or Kingdom) with exactly those settings to earn bonus Renaissance Points, §fonce per day§7.
§7• §e/ws daily§7 shows today's challenge, your reward and your streak.

§6§lReward
§7• §f10 RP§7, plus §f2 RP per streak day§7 (max +10). A streak counts consecutive days.
§7• Multiplied by the difficulty: Normal ×1, Hard ×1.5, Nightmare ×2.
§7• In Kingdom mode, ×1.5 on top.
§7• Stacks with the usual mutator and difficulty bonuses.
codex.sets.hint: §7Each family counts the different relics you have equipped. Bonuses unlock at 2 and 3 pieces, and at 4 pieces for the 4-relic families.
codex.breaches.body:
§7Hordes throw extra threats at you in the middle of the fight.

§6§lBreaches
§7• Rifts open around the Monolith and keep spawning §freinforcements§7 until destroyed.
§7• Destroying one gives a reward. A Breach still open at the end of a wave makes the horde §fstronger§7.
§7• Each horde has its own Breach types (monsters, rewards, looks).

§6§lAnomalies
§7• Glowing circles appear under players and elsewhere in the arena. They turn §cred§7 just before activating, then apply their effects (levitation, slowness, poison, pull…) to §fplayers§7.
§7• §fStep out of the circle§7 before it fires. Slow Falling and the Void Anchor Ring help.

§6§lChaos events
§7• §fTotems§7 (Frenzy, Regeneration, Curse, Summoning) buff the horde until they are destroyed.
§7• §fOre deposits§7 and §ffantasy trees§7: mine or chop them for resources (a minimum tool tier may be needed).
§7• §fChaos merchants§7 sell rare and legendary items, sometimes only for a short time.
§7• §fStorms§7 (some hordes): exposed players freeze and take damage. Stay close to a campfire or another heat source to be sheltered.
codex.blessings.body:
§6§lBlessings
§7• After each wave you pick §fone of 3 blessings§7 (4 with the Lord's Heritage, node 3). In Kingdom mode, every Calm offers them.
§7• Picking the same blessing again raises its §flevel§7 and multiplies its effect.
§7• You keep them if you die, and they are §fdispelled when the horde ends§7.
§7• §e/ws benediction liste§7 shows the full catalogue.

§6§lBlood Pacts
§7• A Pact is a special §fhead item§7. Hold it and §fright-click§7: it rolls a random weighted effect, then goes on cooldown.
§7• A §fsealed§7 pact grants all its effects at once, and sealing it summons the horde.
§7• §e/ws pacte list§7 shows the pacts, §e/ws pacte resetcd§7 resets your cooldown.
codex.objectives.body:
§7Each Calm can offer one optional §fobjective§7 (how often is set in the horde editor). Succeeding is rewarded, ignoring it can cost you. Its timer and progress show on the HUD.

§e• Supply Convoy§7: escort a caravan to the Monolith. Its arrival gives resources.
§e• Gate Champion§7: an elite and its guard come out of a Gate. Take them down for Essence and loot.
§e• Buried Treasure§7: a Treasure Compass points to a hidden chest. Follow the HUD arrow and dig.
§e• Purification§7: corruption hearths appear (they show on the Kingdom map). Break them with any weapon before the Assault: none purified = a stronger next Assault, all purified = a weaker one.
codex.workshop.body:
§7The §fRepair Workshop§7 (a 2×1 block, bought in the Monolith shop) slowly repairs your gear.

§7• Drop damaged armor, weapons and tools into it. Items stay §freserved to the player§7 who dropped them.
§7• Level 1: 2 slots, level 2: 4 slots, level 3: 6 slots, and it repairs faster at each level.
§7• Right-click it to open its sheet and choose a specialization when one is available.

§6§lRepair all
§7In the Monolith shop, §f🔧 Repair all§7 repairs every damaged defense, most damaged first, at the manual repair price. The first click shows a §fquote§7: click again within 10 s to confirm. It stops when the treasury runs out.
codex.tools.body:
§6§lKingdom map
§7Monolith shop › §fTown Hall › Map§7: a view around the Monolith (3 zoom levels, up to 128 blocks) showing the Monolith, defenses, ramparts, traps, enemy Gates, Catalysts, ore deposits, trees, §fcorruption hearths§7 and players. It does not show the buried treasure.

§6§lKingdom Compass
§7Bought in the shop (64 ◆). On the map, §fclick a marker§7 to point the compass at it, §fright-click§7 to clear. It resets by itself when its target is gone (harvested, destroyed or purified).

§6§lScout
§7Each Calm, a scout reports on the next Assault: expected monsters per Gate, special assault, boss, and whether the Gate King awakens. The §f🔭 Scout§7 button shows the report again. The omen and the objective can still change the numbers.

§6§lAssault report
§7At the start of each Calm: monsters slain (players, soldiers, defenses and traps), treasury gains, building damage and destroyed pieces, and the §fMVP§7.
codex.relics.body:
§7Relics are unique items with permanent effects. You find them in §froulette chests§7, with §fchaos merchants§7, and with the §fSealed Reliquary§7.

§6§lEquipping
§7• §fOnly equipped relics work.§7 Put them in the Curios §fRelic§7 slot or, without Curios, equip them at the §fRenaissance Altar › Forge › Equipment§7: 3 slots, +1 per Renaissance rank (6 max).

§6§lLevels
§7• A relic has §flevel I, II (×1.5) or III (×2)§7 of its effects.

§6§lForge §7(Renaissance Altar)
§7• §fUpgrade§7: a duplicate of the relic (consumed) plus RP: §f15 RP§7 for level II, §f30 RP§7 for level III.
§7• §fFuse§7: two specific relics of the same family, both §flevel II or higher§7, plus §f50 RP§7 give one of the 12 §6legendary relics§7. A legendary acts as its two parents at level II (so it counts as 2 set pieces) and adds a unique effect.
§7• §fSealed Reliquary§7: sold in the Renaissance shop (40 RP by default). Right-click for a random base relic, handy to find duplicates for the Forge.
codex.renaissance.body:
§7The §fRenaissance Altar§7 (crafted with crying obsidian, amethyst shards and a respawn anchor) is your permanent progression. It has four tabs: Sacrifice, Shop, Forge and Heritage.

§6§lRenaissance Points (RP)
§7• Earned by §fplaying§7: 1 RP per wave cleared (2 per Assault survived in Kingdom), +1 per boss, +5 on victory, and +15 the first time you win a given horde.
§7• Multiplied by difficulty (×0.75 / ×1 / ×1.5 / ×2) and mutators, then by personal bonuses (+5% per rank, Merchant node 4, Fortune set).
§7• A defeat keeps the wave and boss RP but gives no victory bonus. Stopping a horde with /ws stop gives nothing.
§7• You can also §fsacrifice§7 items of good rarity for RP.

§6§lShop §7and §6§lForge
§7Spend RP on permanent items and stats in the Shop. The Forge upgrades and fuses relics (see the Relics page).

§6§lHeritage tree
§7Three branches of 5 nodes, unlocked in order for §f5 / 10 / 15 / 25 / 40 RP§7.
codex.renaissance.tail:
§6§lRebirth
§7Once you have invested §f60 / 120 / 200 / 300 / 450 RP§7 (Heritage + stats) and won a horde since your last rebirth, you can be reborn, up to rank V. It resets your Heritage and permanent stats, keeps your relics and unspent RP, and gives +1 relic slot, +5% RP, a title and an aura:
codex.interface.body:
§6§lOn screen
§7• §fEvent feed§7 (left of the screen): chaos events, Breaches, Catalysts, merchants and objectives show up here instead of in the chat, for a few seconds each.
§7• §fWave bar§7 (top): monsters left, wave number, countdown to the next wave and pauses.
§7• §fTreasury panel§7 (right, Kingdom mode).
§7• §fArrows§7: some roles get a HUD arrow (the Arcanist towards Catalysts and corruption hearths, the Miner towards deposits). The Buried Treasure objective gives one to everybody.

§6§lCommands for everyone
§e/ws codex§7: this guide
§e/ws info§7: current horde, wave and monsters left
§e/ws resume§7 and §e/ws abandon§7: resume or drop an interrupted game
§e/ws retry§7: reconsecrate a fallen altar and try again
§e/ws benediction liste§7: blessings catalogue
§e/ws pacte list§7: Blood Pacts
§e/renaissance§7: opens the Renaissance menu; §e/renaissance shop§7 and §e/renaissance points§7 (your RP)
codex.start.body:
§fWave Survivor§7: defend your position against waves of monsters.

§6§lStarting a horde
§7• Place a §fRunic Altar§7 and offer it a horde's ingredients to seal it.
§7• Right-click the sealed altar: pick the variant, §fdifficulty§7 and §fmutators§7, then launch.
§7• Shift + click (twice within 5 s) unbinds the altar, except during a horde.
§7• Some hordes are locked: their conditions are shown at the altar.

§6§lDuring the horde
§7• If the horde enables defense, protect and repair the §fMonolith§7: if it falls, the horde wins and the altar is desecrated (it must be reconsecrated).
§7• An interrupted game can be resumed at the start of its wave.

§6§lCommands
§e/ws codex§7: this guide · §e/ws info§7: information · §e/ws editor§7: editor (OP)
codex.classic.body:
§7Monsters arrive in §fwaves§7, each bigger than the last. More players means more and tougher monsters.

§6§lAs the game goes on
§7• §fSpecial waves§7: unusual line-ups, announced in chat.
§7• §fBosses§7: on specific waves (see the Bosses page).
§7• §fMerchants§7: villagers offering trades.
§7• §fPauses§7: breathers between some waves.
§7• §fChaos events§7: ore deposits to mine, gravity anomalies, totems, breaches… mid-fight.
§7• §fRoulette chests§7: mystery chests opened with keys dropped by monsters.

§6§lForced wave end
§7When only a few monsters remain, they glow through walls and a countdown starts. At zero, stragglers vanish without loot and the game goes on.

§6§lVictory
§7Survive the last wave to claim the rewards.

§6§lRoulette chests & keys
§7Monsters drop §fkeys§7. Right-click a Roulette Chest with a matching key to spin it (left-click previews its loot). Reliquary keys open the themed chests: Boss, Treasures, Nether, End, Abyss and Arcane.

§6§lLeaderboard
§7At the end of a horde, the top 3 players and the boss killer receive rewards.
codex.difficulty.body: §7Difficulty and mutators are chosen at the altar before launching. The harder it gets, the better the rewards. Some mutators are ignored in Kingdom mode.
codex.boss.body:
§7Bosses appear on specific waves and are announced in chat. Some summon minions, surround themselves with §fprotective totems§7 (destroy them to make the boss vulnerable) or wait in their §farena§7: a portal then opens near the altar after the last wave.
§7A boss can also carry affixes that change how it fights.
codex.kingdom.body:
§7§fGates§7 open in a ring around the Monolith. Goal: destroy them all.

§6§lThe cycle
§7• §cAssault§7: the horde pours out of the Gates in squads, with §fsiege units§7 (Rams, Sappers, Climbers) targeting your buildings.
§7• §aCalm§7: rebuild, trade and prepare for the next Assault. Small breaches still release a few monsters.

§6§lTaking down a Gate
§7A Gate is sealed. Kill its §fGuardians§7, then destroy the §fCatalyst§7 that appears near it: the Gate is breached and can be struck. Be quick, it can seal again.

§6§lThe King's Gate
§7The last Gate becomes the King's Gate: its final boss appears on the planned Assault, or earlier if you make it falter. Depending on the horde, it waits for you in its arena.

§6§lDeath & survival
§7Solo, dying loses the game. In multiplayer, you return to the Monolith after 10 s; the game is lost if everyone falls. Inventory is kept during the game.

§6§lEvery Calm
§7Blessings, merchants and roulette chests.

§6§lBuilding rules
§7• §fFoundations are required§7: a defense must rest entirely on solid ground and be reachable by monsters (no pillars). One that loses its support collapses a few seconds after a warning.
§7• Every Calm brings §fguaranteed resources§7 (deposits and trees) around the kingdom.
§7• The game is §fsaved and resumed§7 with the world: when you come back, a chat message offers to resume the kingdom from the start of its Calm.
codex.treasury.body:
§7The kingdom shares a §fcommon treasury§7 (panel on the right of the screen).

§e• Money ◆§7: every emerald picked up goes into it. « Withdraw 10 ◆ » (Monolith) turns it back into emeralds for merchants.
§e• Stone, Wood, Iron§7: +1 per natural block broken (placed blocks don't count). A destroyed deposit gives Stone and Iron, a felled tree gives Wood (based on size).
§e• Breach Essence§7: Catalyst destroyed +3, Guardians defeated +5, breach exhausted +5, boss +3. Deposits and trees give some too.

§7These resources pay for upgrades, defenses, walls, traps and the Town Hall.
codex.monolith.body:
§7Right-click the Monolith to open its shop:
§e• Upgrades§7: Monolith health, regeneration and armor.
§e• Defenses§7: towers, shrine, barracks, Gleaner.
§e• Walls & Traps§7: ramparts, gates, traps (and the Builder's charge).
§e• 🏛 Town Hall§7: each level expands the kingdom (claim +4 blocks) and gives the Monolith +100 HP; some levels unlock level-2 defenses and specializations.
§e• ♟ Roles§7: role, flasks, omens.

§7You can only build inside your kingdom (the claim around the Monolith).
codex.defenses.body:
§7Your buildings have HP: monsters, especially siege units, go after them. Upgrade them with money (Town Hall required) and repair them.

§6§lSheet & barracks orders
§7Right-click a defense to see its sheet (level, HP, specialization). On a barracks, give its soldiers an order: §fHold§7, §fMonolith§7 or §fPatrol§7. The §fCommander§7 also has §fFollow me§7 (soldiers escort you, +20% damage and speed within 12 blocks) and the §fRallying Horn§7 (right-click: plants a banner where you aim, soldiers go there for 60 s; sneak + right-click recalls them).
codex.roles.body: §7Each player can take a role, and each role belongs to one player only. Pick it at the altar or in the Monolith's Roles tab; it is final until the end of the horde.
codex.alchemy.body: §7Alchemist only. Each monster killed gives reagents; during the Calm, spend them (Roles tab) to brew or upgrade throwable flasks (levels 1 to 3). Right-click to throw.
codex.omens.body: §7Augur only. Every Calm, 3 omens are offered (different from the previous time): pick one in chat or in the Roles tab. The omen lasts a single Assault, with an upside and a drawback.
codex.editor.body:
§7Operators only: §e/ws editor§7.

§e• New horde§7: start from a template (Short classic, Long classic, Kingdom or Empty).
§e• ✔ Check§7: lists problems; click one to jump to the right tab.
§e• Preview§7: content of each wave, « ▶ Test wave » to spawn it, « ✖ Clear » to remove it.
§e• 📤 Export / 📥 Import§7: share a complete horde as a .zip (config/wavesurvivor/export and import).
§e• 📋 Copy / Paste§7: hordes, mobs and bosses through the clipboard.
§e• Entities & skills§7: custom monsters and skills.
